verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents a self-serve 30-day free trial and out-of-the-box lead, opportunity and pipeline management, so a founder can sign up and get a basic pipeline without a partner. Nothing in the pack shows importing real data or reaching a working pipeline within an hour, and community comments describe heavy customization and consultant reliance. Missing for 10: documented data import/migration tooling, evidence of setup completing within an hour, a guided onboarding flow, and independent hands-on confirmation of partner-free setup.
